name: NAVI CHARACTER
purpose: Navigation character images for TT-sensei elementary web learning materials
rules: Verify all IDs, filenames and paths in catalog.json before use.
Use characters as visual guidance, not as problem text or controls.
Keep image URLs centralized in the lesson application.
Use meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative images.
For standard individual character images, choose randomly from all six character IDs by default instead of assigning one character to each subject or event.
Choose the scene-appropriate pose separately from the character ID; verify pose availability in catalog.json.
A full rotation or persistent random order is not required; avoid duplicates among simultaneously displayed characters when practical.
